inline_comments.comment: The documented default (`true`) contradicts the actual implementation. In `common-preset.ts` the flag is set to `changeDetection: false`, and the JSDoc in `core-common.ts` correctly annotates `@default false`. This will mislead users who consult the docs to understand the out-of-the-box behavior. Change this line to `Default: \`false\`.

The TODO comment (`TODO: Turn to true before 10.4 release`) has no associated tracking issue. Per project convention, TODO comments must include a link to a GitHub issue so the action item isn't silently forgotten (e.g., `TODO: Turn to true before 10.4 release, see #<issue-number>`). If this PR is the right time to track that work, create the issue and reference it here before merging.

"Enable change detection." is too terse to be useful documentation. Users reading this have no way to understand what Storybook's change detection actually tracks (e.g., story file edits, HMR events, etc.), when they would want to enable it, or what observable difference it makes. Add at least one sentence describing the feature's purpose and, where possible, link to a deeper guide or the tracking issue.
